snippet.title: BLOBBELNOPPEL Anniversary Trailer 1
snippet.description:
This trailer was made to celebrate BLOBBELNOPPEL's 2nd anniversary in development. It does not indicate that the game is anywhere near finished.

Stay updated on the game at blobbelnoppel.bsky.social, or on Twitter/Instagram @BLOBBELNOPPEL

A stolen lunchbox and a looming threat to freedom as they know it kickstart Blobithan's adventure with his friends climbing mysterious islands and slaying unique foes to ultimately make it to The Castle and slay the evil, and frankly creepy, dictator known as The King. Join Blobithan, Clobbler, and Topithort on a once-in-a-lifetime adventure to free Grouterplort from the shackles of The King (and more importantly, get Blobithan's lunchbox back) in this unique and stylized dungeon crawler made in RPG Maker.

BLOBBELNOPPEL currently has no planned release date.
